notes.title: Update Log V.0.0.1.02
notes.content:
[b]Somewhere: Sect of Relic is updated[/b]

[list]
[*]Saving UI problem is fixed,
[*]Minor improvements were made on user interface,
[*]Flashlight intensity has been increased,
[*]Direction light intensity has been increased,
[*]Fixed the issue where the enemy stays high on the terrain,
[*]Linux build released,

[/list]

notes.title: Now It's totally scarier!
notes.content:
Hello Folks,

We apologize for the late update but it will be worth it.

A lot has changed with the new update. With this update, it contains many new and fixed content. Achievements will come back with trading cards in the future. Currently, there is only a renewed version for windows. However, updates for Mac and Linux will come soon. The new trailer will come soon.
We hope you like it.


Fixes

EnemyAI has been renewed. 
Player has has renewed.
Brightness setting changed.
Objectives has been reorganized.
Pick up and examine system reorganized.
Texts has been renewed.

New Features


Save/Load system added. Checkpoint system deleted.
New puzzles has been added.
New jumpscares has been added.
Voice actor added. 
Dynamic sky added. 
Two new creatures has been added. Old ones were deleted
New Main Menu added.
Advanced Option added.
New Inventory System added.
New axe added. Old one were deleted.
New flashlight added. Old one were deleted.
New health packs added.
Combine system added.
Remote control added.


and more...

Hope you have fun. Now It's totally scarier.
Your feedback is very important to us.

Junla Games
